.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(slam))

translation.description: Apply a function to row pairs by transposing into crossapply.
translation.details: Apply a function to row pairs by transposing into crossapply.

translation.example:
import numpy as np
from slam import simple_triplet_matrix, tcrossapply_simple_triplet_matrix
m = simple_triplet_matrix([1, 2, 1], [1, 1, 2], [1, 2, 3], 2, 2)
print(tcrossapply_simple_triplet_matrix(m, fun=lambda a, b: float(np.sum(a * b))))
